entries.title: Joshua 9:1
segments:
This side Jordan; the west side, where the Israelites then were. 
 
  The great sea; the Mediterranean.

entries.title: Joshua 9:2
segments: No combination or power of wicked men, if they continue in sin, sill save them from ruin.

entries.title: Joshua 9:3
segments: Gibeon; a large city of the Hivites, a few miles north-west of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Joshua 9:4
segments:
Wilily; craftily, deceitfully. 
 
  Wine-bottles; these were made of the skins of animals.

entries.title: Joshua 9:6
segments: A league; an agreement not to destroy them.

entries.title: Joshua 9:8
segments: A knowledge of the truth, the will, and purposes of God, leads some to oppose and others to submit themselves to him.

entries.title: Joshua 9:14
segments: If men do not ask counsel of God, and seek his direction, they may expect to be habitually and grossly deceived.

entries.title: Joshua 9:18
segments: Sworn unto them; that their lives should be preserved.

entries.title: Joshua 9:19
segments: Solemn engagements to do things which are practicable, and not wicked, should be sacredly observed.  He that changeth not, when he sweareth even "to his own hurt," shall dwell in God's holy hill, and "shall never be moved."

entries.title: Joshua 9:21
segments: Hewers of wood and drawers of water; especially for the services of religion.

entries.title: Joshua 9:27
segments:
In the place which he should choose; for the sanctuary and for public worship. 
 
The sins of men are sometimes overruled for their good; but this does not lessen the evil of such sins, or the guilt of those who commit them.
